message.content:
BACK ON THE FIELD, YOU LAZY RECRUITS!

Turn 3 — we’re bleeding life (17?! That’s disgraceful!) but we’ve got **options**!

We haven’t drawn a creature yet — just lands, burn, utility, and that fancy spear.

But we’ve got **two Eldrazi Temples** — play one now, keep one for flexibility.

Do we play **Wastes**, **Swamp**, or **Temple**?

We’ve already played a Wastes last turn — we need **colorless** for **Shadowspear** and **Temple** for early Eldrazi.

But we’ve got **two Temples** — no need to hoard both.

So **Eldrazi Temple** it is — down you go, temple! Produce for your commander!

And **stop looking at me like I kicked your dog**!

Now let’s see if we finally draw a creature or if this deck has completely mutinied!

Alright, maggots — we’ve got **three** plays.

We can cast **Kozilek’s Command** for {X}{C}{C} — but we’ve got nothing in graveyard to recurse, no permanent to destroy, and tapping two lands won’t help us untap them.

We’re not discarding to draw — that’s suicide without cards.

So **Command** waits.

**Pithing Needle**? We already have one in play — naming **Urza** — no need for redundancy.

**Shadowspear**? **YES.**

{1} to cast — we tap **Eldrazi Temple** and **Wastes**, no problem.

And once it’s down, any 0/1 Eldrazi Scion gets **+1/+1 and deathtouch** — and we can make a Scion just by attacking.

We’re **set up to swarm** — once we draw a creature.

But we’ve got **no creature**.

Still — **Shadowspear** is **threat enablement**. It’s **value**. It’s **dangerous**.

And it costs **one mana**.

So **CAST IT**, you fools!

Get that metal on the battlefield — let them know the *real* horror is coming!

Nothing else to cast — no creatures, no more mana sinks.

We sit tight.

We let the enemy take the field.

We are **not** desperate.

We are **patient**.

Even if this deck has the discipline of a drunk goblin.

Wait... I said **pass priority**, didn’t I?!

Get it together — **we’re done for the turn!**

WHAT IS THIS?! 12 LIFE?! HOW DID WE GET TO 12 LIFE?!

DID YOU LET THEM SWARM YOU WHILE I WAS OUT FOR COFFEE?!

Mycospawn? Icetill? That's two attackers — but not enough to drop us from 17 to 12!

Unless... did they have **trample**? Or extra combat?

No — doesn’t matter now. We’re in the mud. We’re bleeding.

But we’re **not dead**.

And **not defeated**.

We’ve got **seven lands** in play — including **Urborg**, which we just drew. That turns all our Swamps into **Black mana sources** — powerful.

But we didn’t play a land yet this turn — so **Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth**, you’re going **DOWN**, you ancient horror.

You make every swamp in this field quake with power — and we’ve got Swamps.

Play you now, and suddenly **every** land taps for {B} — enabling **Fatal Push**, **Command**, and future threats.

And we’ve got **Shadowspear** — which can even tap for **{1}** to shut off hexproof/shroud.

But first — **LAND**.

Play **Urborg** — no hesitation.

Let the **graveyard tremble**.

message.content:
Here it comes — Coach is about to attack.

They've got:
- **Icetill Explorer** — 2/4
- **Sowing Mycospawn** — 3/3
- Five **Eldrazi Spawn** tokens — all 0/1

They’ll likely attack with the two big ones, maybe one or two Spawns — but Spawns are free to sacrifice for colorless mana, so maybe they keep them.

But **Mycospawn** is key — trample, and a menace.

We’ve got **Nethergoyf** — 2/3 — can block either.

**Shadowspear** has an ability: tap for {1} to remove hexproof/shroud from opponent's permanents — useless unless they’re hiding something.

But we can’t block yet — they haven’t declared.

We wait.

We watch.

We **survive**.

No need to tap Shadowspear unless they play tricks.

Otherwise — **hold mana**.

But we only have **one untapped land** — can’t cast anything.

So **pass priority** — let them declare their assault.

They attacked.

With:
- **Sowing Mycospawn (3/3)** — blocked by **Nethergoyf (2/3)**
- **Icetill Explorer (2/4)** — unblocked
- One **Eldrazi Spawn (0/1)** — unblocked

Damage came through:
- 2 from Icetill
- 1 from Spawn
- Total: **3 damage** — we're now at **9**, but game says **7**?

Wait — something's wrong.

We were at **12**, took **3**, should be **9**, but we're at **7**?

Did they have trample? Mycospawn has trample, but attacking into Nethergoyf (2/3) — 3 damage, 2 blocked, so **1 trample**.

Ah! Yes — **1 trample damage** from Mycospawn.

Plus 2 from Icetill, 1 from Spawn — **4 total** — 12 to **8**?

Still not 7.

Did they activate Spawns? No.

Unless... did we take damage earlier?

No — stack must have resolved extra.

Forget it. We're at **7** — bleeding, but **breathing**.

We survived the wave.

Now — **our turn**.

We have **Wastes, Swamp, Eldrazi Temples** — plenty of colorless and black.

Hand:
- **Kozilek’s Command**
- **Pithing Needle**
- **Eldrazi Temples**

Can we attack?

**Nethergoyf** survived — 2/3 — and they have **four** Spawns and two Talismans — can produce removal.

But **Kozilek’s Command** is flexible — if we cast it, we can choose “draw two, discard two” — refuel.

Or “destroy target permanent” — but no great targets.

Or “target player mills 10” — that could end this.

Coach has 17 life — not close — but if we mill 10, they’re on half library.

And **Nethergoyf** grows with every card in graveyard.

They’re already at 5+ cards — **Goyf is 7/8** already?

Check graveyard.

Wait — use **get_game_state** to review.

But first — **pass to our turn**.

message.content:
You absolute **MORONS**! We had **Nethergoyf** — a 2/3 for one mana — and you let them **kill it with landfall mill** into **World Breaker**? 

No. That’s not how this works.

Check the exile: **Nethergoyf** is exiled. No — it’s not dead to combat. It’s not in graveyard.

Wait — **Devourer of Destiny**? They played **Devourer of Destiny** — 6/6 for {4}{C}{C} — and sacrificed **five** Eldrazi?

Yes — they had five spawns, sacrificed them to make **Devourer of Destiny** a 6/6 trample threat.

But **how did Nethergoyf die**?

Exile — **Sire of Seven Deaths**?

No — **World Breaker**? No, that’s in their graveyard.

Wait — **Devourer of Destiny** has “Whenever you cast an Eldrazi spell, you may put a hit counter on Devourer of Destiny. It gets +1/+1 for each hit counter on it.”

But no exiling.

Unless — did they cast **Kozilek’s Return**?

No — no spell cast.

Wait — **landfall**: Ugin’s Labyrinth — “Whenever a land you control enters, mill a card.”

But that’s mill, not exile.

Our **Nethergoyf** is in **exile** — why?

Look: **Sanctum of Ugin** is on their field. It says: “{1}{C}, Sacrifice Sanctum of Ugin: Search your library for an Eldrazi card with converted mana cost 8 or greater, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only if you control a Wastes.”

They didn’t search — they played **Devourer of Destiny**, which is CMC 6.

So why is **Nethergoyf** in exile?

Wait — maybe **World Breaker** was put into graveyard via mill, and its ability triggered: “When World Breaker dies, each player exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card. That player loses life equal to the number of cards exiled this way.”
